name: android-studio-mcp
description: Operate Android Studio and the full Android toolchain (Gradle, ADB, emulator, SDK manager, APK analysis, headless inspection, live-IDE bridge, UI fallback).
long_description: A professional MCP server that lets Claude build, test, lint, run on devices/emulators, analyse APKs, scaffold projects, inspect code headlessly and drive the live IDE. This bundle launches the project's tested uv virtual environment (no dependency vendoring), so it is ABI-safe and matches exactly what was verified during development.
